consent.title: Before we start
consent.termsLabel: I agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy
consent.disclaimerLabel: I understand this app is not medical advice
consent.doctorLabel: The parent has consulted a doctor about the exercises
consent.intro: Care Journal helps adult children motivate their parents to do simple exercises every day.

slide1.title: Care Journal
slide1.body: An app where children thank their parents for daily exercise

slide2.title: You do the exercises
slide2.body: Every day — a short 10–25 minute exercise set. The camera follows the exercise, AI checks the technique and credits the reward.

slide3.title: Care that pays off
slide3.body: Your child pays for every completed day and you see what you have earned

slide4.title: Health and money grow
slide4.body: Regular activity strengthens the heart and muscles and improves sleep and mood — research proves it.

camera.title: Camera access needed
camera.body: The camera lets AI check that the exercise was really done. No video is recorded; a few moments of the exercise are seen only by your child and are deleted after 7 days. Without the camera the exercise can't be counted.

medical.title: Important
medical.body: If during the exercise you feel chest pain, severe dizziness or sharp joint pain — stop and rest. This is not medical advice: consult a doctor before starting.

exercise.getReady: Get ready — step back so your whole body is visible

skip.hint: No need to repeat: do the other exercises in any order. A skipped exercise earns nothing.
skip.confirmBody: This exercise won't earn anything today. The other exercises stay available — do them in any order.
skip.done: Exercise skipped. Go on with the others
skip.doneDay: Exercise skipped — the day is complete

empty.title: No entries yet

dashboard.noFamily: Your parent has not joined yet. Create a code and send it: progress will appear here once they join.

plan.reminderHint: At this time your parent gets a “Time to exercise” notification
plan.appliesFromTomorrow: Changes apply from the next day
plan.typesHint: Choose workout types: only exercises of these types will be in the day (from tomorrow).

durationTip.a: Good start! 10 minutes is enough for the first weeks. Regularity is key.
durationTip.b: Optimal for beginners: 10–25 min is the recommended range excluding walking.
durationTip.c: Good level. Make sure there is no strong fatigue after the session.
durationTip.d: 40+ minutes may be too much for beginners. We suggest starting with 15–25 min.

plan.autoConfirmBody: Every week reps, seconds and steps will grow by {{pct}}% (at most double). You can turn it off any time.
plan.typesAiNote: AI is choosing exercises now: every session is mixed (strength, core, cardio). These types apply when AI selection is off in “Exercises”.

reminder.title: Alarm

reminder.testDenied: Allow notifications in your phone settings

unavailable.body: This phone has no step sensor, so this exercise can't be counted. Ask your child to replace it in the program.

today.denied: Step counter access is turned off in phone settings.

dayDetail.nothingPlanned: No workout planned for this day.

parents.inviteHint: Send the code — as soon as they enter it in their app, they will appear in the switcher.

overall.upBody: The load has grown — a great result. Keep the same rhythm.
overall.downBody: There is less movement. Try adding short walks between exercises.
overall.sameBody: Keep the rhythm — consistency matters more than records.

steps.upBody: Average steps grew by {{pct}}%. Walking lowers the risk of heart disease.
steps.downBody: Average steps dropped by {{pct}}%. Try a short walk after meals.
steps.noneBody: Steps will appear here once the parent turns on the step counter on their phone.
steps.sameBody: Step count hasn't changed. Try adding a short walk.

workouts.upBody: The share of completed days grew by {{pct}}%. Muscles get stronger with regular load.
workouts.downBody: More days are missed. It is better to lower the load than to skip entirely.
workouts.sameBody: The share of completed days hasn't changed. Every scheduled workout builds strength.

flex.upBody: Regular exercise improves joint mobility and coordination — the risk of falls goes down.
flex.downBody: With less activity joints get stiffer. Add 5 minutes of stretching daily.

sleep.upBody: Research shows regular exercise improves sleep quality in adults.
sleep.downBody: Less movement is often linked to worse sleep and mood. Even 10 minutes of movement helps.

accounts.expired: This account’s session has expired — sign in again via “Add account”.

voice.getReady: Get ready. Put the phone down and step back so your whole body is visible.

money.tapHint: Tap a tile to see what the amount means

fund.label: Fund
fund.explain: Money the sponsor sets aside in advance for rewards — for a month, 5 months or years ahead. Each accepted exercise takes its share of the daily rate from the fund. How long it lasts depends on the balance, the daily rate and the number of workout days.
fund.depositHint: Enter an amount or choose how many months of workouts to cover at the current plan.
fund.depositNote: Bookkeeping only: money is transferred outside the app (bank, BLIK).

earned.label: Earned for activity
earned.explain: The amount that builds up from completed workouts: every accepted exercise adds its share of the daily rate. Shown here for all time.

settled.label: Paid out in total
settled.explain: The total paid to the parent — net, excluding bank or payment fees. Only confirmed transfers count.

owed.label: To pay out
owed.explain: Earned but not paid yet: “Earned for activity” minus “Paid out in total”. This is the amount the sponsor transfers to the parent.
